cases.name: kotlin: clauses, lists and conditions
cases.sql: select u.id,u.name, count(*) as orders from users u left join orders o on o.user_id=u.id where u.active = true and o.total>=10 or u.vip group by u.id,u.name order by orders desc limit 10

cases.name: kotlin: single items stay on the clause line
kotlin: subqueries, calls and IN lists
cases.sql: SELECT name FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders WHERE total > coalesce(1,2)) AND status IN ('a','b')

cases.name: kotlin: strings, comments, quoted identifiers, casts
cases.sql:
select 'select  from' as "Select", x::text -- keep  me
from t

cases.name: kotlin: between and separated statements
cases.sql: select * from t where a between 1 and 5 and b < -1; delete from t where a = 2;

cases.name: kotlin: insert, update and set lists
cases.sql: insert into t (a, b) values (1, 'x'); update t set a=1, b=2 where id=3

cases.name: kotlin: lower case with tab indent
cases.sql: select id, name from users where active and vip

cases.name: union, joins and offsets
cases.sql: select a from t union all select b from u inner join v on u.id = v.id and v.x > 1 order by 1 limit 5 offset 10

cases.name: cte with nested subquery
cases.sql: with recursive r as (select 1 union select n+1 from r where n < 3) select * from r where x in (with q as (select 2) select * from q)

cases.name: comments and unary minus
cases.sql:
/* head */ select -1, a - -2, +3 -- tail
, b from t where c = -d # x

cases.name: call-like keywords and table names
cases.sql: insert into s.t (a) select cast(x as int), replace(y, 'a', 'b'), left(z, 2), exists (select 1) from s.u join w (q) on true returning a, b

cases.name: delete with having
cases.sql: delete from t where a in (select a from u group by a having count(*) > 1 or max(b) < 2)

cases.name: parenthesised expressions
cases.sql: select (a + b) * c, f(  x  ) from t where (a = 1 or b = 2) and c = 3
